105: Write endpoints on authenticated routes are rate-limited per-user (not per-calendar). Rate limiting is active

Author: David Hajnal <128488614+david-hajnal@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Sun Sep 27 14:43:53 2026 +0200

    Codex/ics import (#2)
    
    * feat(caldav): slice 1 secure tracer — connection password + PROPFIND /dav/
    
    Add the CalDAV account foundation: revocable hashed connection credentials,
    a Basic-auth DAV router serving PROPFIND /dav/ with the current-principal
    link, and the browser connection-management API.
    
    - migration 0023: caldav_accounts + caldav_credentials (+rollback)
    - caldav/{mod,types,auth,http}: issue/revoke/authenticate (constant-time,
      same-shape failures), PROPFIND /dav/ 207, connection-management routes
    - config: CALDAV_PUBLIC_ORIGIN (prod requires https, no path)
    - main: DAV + connection routers merged separately from browser/CSRF
    - frontend: settings route + connection card stub (secret shown once)
    - e2e: issue password -> PROPFIND /dav/ principal link + 401 unauth
    
    Test plan: cargo test/clippy/fmt green; pnpm frontend test/lint/typecheck
    green; pnpm e2e 4 passed. Review fixed a timing/user-enumeration leak in
    authenticate (dummy-HMAC equalization).
    
    * feat(caldav): slice 2 principal discovery — well-known, OPTIONS, principal props
    
    Add the CalDAV discovery chain so a client can reach the user's calendar
    home: RFC 6764 service discovery, DAV capability advertisement, and
    principal properties.
    
    - GET /.well-known/caldav -> 301 to absolute /dav/ (unauthenticated)
    - OPTIONS on /dav/, /dav/principals/:id/, /dav/calendars/:id/ ->
      DAV: 1, 2, access-control, calendar-access + Allow
    - PROPFIND /dav/principals/:id/ -> 207 principal-URL, calendar-home-set,
      displayname (xml-escaped), supported-report-set
    - cross-user principal -> 404 (no existence leak); Depth: infinity -> 400
    - auth.rs: dav_root_url, calendar_home_url, resolve_principal
    - e2e: full discovery chain well-known -> OPTIONS -> PROPFIND -> principal
    
    Test plan: cargo test/clippy/fmt green; pnpm e2e 4 passed. Review fixed a
    DB-error->404 masking (now 500).
    
    * feat: import editable ICS calendar files
    
    ---------
    
    Co-authored-by: david-hajnal <david@hajnal.space>
